meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be direct: why does my son have a zero, and why did he find out from the gradebook on his phone?
I didn't come in to be thanked, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: the principal

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's English 30-1 essay withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and an explanation of who decided on the zero and why I was not called before it was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on who decided; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended long before her time ran out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you gave her no evidence and no answer to her questions.
What cost ground: You opened with a pleasantry and did not answer who decided on the zero or whether Owen was heard first, which left her holding the procedure complaint alone.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you had not yet shown anything about the essay, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: After her first questions, own in one sentence that the zero was entered before you called her, then put a dated document she can check on the table.
